hypothesized_consumers.hypothesis: Clinic managers reading panel/cohort CSVs might notice a one-time missing-field abort if pick() is not taught identifier.value, but they would not see ssn/name either before or after.
hypothesized_consumers.evidence_trail: Collector guard exits nonzero above 0.5% missing picked fields; aggregations never see ssn/name.
hypothesized_consumers.confirm_by: M4 probe: run collect:demographics against PIS v3 and compare CSV golden numbers to baseline.

rating_rationale: No person-facing surface in this repo shows ssn, name, or patientId. Published reports are gender/dob/zip aggregates.
rating_would_change_if: A CSV or dashboard tile included patientId or a name, or a runbook told analysts to spot-check identity fields in snapshots.
